title: Name platform/ci/*.test.mjs in the merge checklist (coverage red on main)
problem: PR 16739 added *.test.mjs files under platform/ci/ without the matching checklist line, so platform/ci/checklist_coverage.py (the 'coverage' job and one 'validate' job) fails on main and on every PR that merges main in.
evidence: PR 16737 check runs 133702560586 (coverage) and 133702560240 (validate), 2026-11-16: 'platform/ci/  ->  add: node --test platform/ci/*.test.mjs'
python3 platform/ci/checklist_coverage.py on origin/main reproduces it
change: Add 'node --test platform/ci/*.test.mjs' to the checklist in .github/prompts/verify-and-merge.md, in its own small PR (control plane: .github/ is in CODEOWNERS).
